reference.basis: Each bank's standard AMD term deposit for 1,000,000 AMD and 12 months, interest paid at maturity, opened in a branch; the headline adds any online-opening bonus. Card-linked uplifts are added only where a 1m AMD depositor qualifies.

source.name: fininfo.am (Central Bank of Armenia comparison tool): AMD term deposits, 1,000,000 AMD, 1 year

tax: Interest is taxed at 10% at source.
guarantee: AMD deposits are guaranteed by the Deposit Guarantee Fund up to 16m AMD per depositor per bank.

FastBank.online_note: Same rate in branches and in the app.
notes: Top-ups allowed; the only term deposit Fast Bank offers.
Early withdrawal: interest recalculated at 4% a year (31-366 days).
src: Fast Bank: Time Deposit with Replenishment (updated 13 Apr 2026)

notes: Monthly payout is a separate product, the Monthly deposit (8.10%, yield 8.41%).

Ameriabank.online_note: +0.1% when opened in the MyAmeria app.
Ameriabank.pkg: Premium +0.25% / Partner +0.35% on term deposits, but the packages need 40m / 120m AMD in average balances.
notes: fininfo.am also lists option variants (top-up or partial withdrawal) at 6.4-7.7%, paid monthly.
src: Ameriabank: Premium and Partner packages, ed. 22 (effective 22 Aug 2026)

notes: The top-up version pays 8.25% but only for 367-549 days.

Conversebank.online_note: The +0.25% online bonus applies only to terms over one year.
notes: Partial withdrawals allowed down to the minimum balance.
fininfo.am still lists older rows for Progress (9.00% / 8.50%); the bank's page shows 8.50% / 8.00%.

Evocabank.product: Classical deposit (Evoca Online pays the same)
Evocabank.online_note: Evoca Online pays the same for this term.

IDBank.online_note: +0.3% when opened in the Idram&IDBank app or IDBanking.am.
notes: The top-up version pays 7.70% at maturity / 7.20% monthly.
src: IDBank: Safe deposit, without top-up (updated 14 Sep 2026)

uplift_notes: Ameriabank: Premium / Partner packages add +0.25% / +0.35% to term deposits and +1% to AMD savings accounts, but need 40m / 120m AMD in average balances. They come with the premium cards, not the other way round.
IDBank: the VISAGOLD package (Visa Gold debit) adds +0.5% to a savings account, not to term deposits.
Converse Bank: the student card (outside the tiers) advertises better deposit terms without a published number.
Fast Bank: no deposit uplift; the link runs the other way, deposits waive the card's annual fee.
